page.overview:
What is Cynothoglys?

Cynothoglys (also known as The Mortician God and She Whose Hand Embalms) is a fictional entity created by Thomas Ligotti for his 1986 short story "The Prodigy of Dreams". In the Second Edition of Malleus Monstrorum, Cynothoglys is known as Cythulos.

Cynothoglys being appears as a shapeless, multiform entity with a single arm used for catching those who summoned her, and bringing them a painless, ecstatic death.

In ancient times, she once held a small cult in Italy, which paid her homage rather than worshiping her, since actual worship would be the same as summoning the god. They considered her to be no mere Cloacina (a Roman goddess of sewers and purification, associated with Venus), but the mortician of all creatures, even the gods themselves.
